ApiTransportMetadata.description: Authority and snapshot facts carried outside versioned method results.

CanonicalEventRecord.description:
Minimal normalized event envelope; never a raw payload.

Output content is referenced, not embedded: ``item_id`` resolves the owning
item, whose ``output_evidence`` carries the retained processed evidence.

CanonicalEventUsage.description: Native numeric usage measurements for one usage-observation event.

CanonicalItemDetail.description: Bounded typed item detail; never a raw body.

CanonicalResourceCoverage.description: Per-resource bounded-evidence coverage for items and events.

ChronicleEvent.description:
Minimal normalized event envelope; never a raw payload.

References the owning item's output evidence through ``item_id`` instead of
carrying any body. ``sequence`` is the deterministic source order within
the session.

ChronicleToolOutputEvidence.description:
Deterministic, bounded evidence describing one item's tool output.

Owned once by the canonical item and referenced from event envelopes.
Raw output never enters this model: only lifecycle, exact measurements with
tokenizer provenance, truncation state, allowlisted structured facts, and
(for declared allowlisted processors) a bounded redacted preview.

LivingScope.description: Optional hierarchy scope for living-event snapshot and delta reads.

OverviewActivity.description:
One semantic activity cell, not one canonical item.

Fields mirror build_overview_flows; descriptions and evidence membership
belong to that projector. Prepared object/response byte limits still apply.

ProjectionCoverage.description:
Honest bounded-evidence coverage for summary/search/overview results.

``retention`` distinguishes how much raw content the authority retained:
``not_applicable`` (no content concept), ``not_retained`` (measured but
discarded), ``preview`` (bounded redacted preview), ``complete`` (never for
sanitized content). ``searchable`` declares searchable completeness.

ToolOutputEvidence.description: Public mirror of the retained per-item output evidence fact.

schema.description: One graph's complete, deterministic, bounded publication facts.
schema.title: PublishedFactSet
